# gns3 Provider

Manages projects, nodes and links on a GNS3 server through its REST API. This release talks to GNS3 server 2.2.x over the v2 API (`/v2/...`). Each argument falls back to its environment variable, then to its default.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    gns3 = {
      source  = "JerryBalmer1/gns3"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# Every argument is optional. Unset arguments fall back to GNS3_HOST,
# GNS3_PORT, GNS3_USERNAME, GNS3_PASSWORD and GNS3_TOKEN, then to the
# defaults (http://127.0.0.1:3080, no auth).
provider "gns3" {
  host = "127.0.0.1"
  port = 3080
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) GNS3 server host name or address. Environment: `GNS3_HOST`. Default `127.0.0.1`.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification when `scheme` is `https`. Default `false`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for HTTP Basic auth. Environment: `GNS3_PASSWORD`.
- `port` (Number) GNS3 server port. Environment: `GNS3_PORT`. Default `3080`.
- `scheme` (String) `http` or `https`. Default `http`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) JWT bearer token for the GNS3 3.x v3 API. Environment: `GNS3_TOKEN`. Accepted for forward compatibility; this release speaks only the v2 API and ignores it, with a warning.
- `username` (String) User for HTTP Basic auth (the `user` setting under `[Server]` with `auth = True` in `gns3_server.conf`). Environment: `GNS3_USERNAME`.
